opener_error_transfer_added_term_vs_base.classification_evidence: Interval crosses zero (-1.50, 0.26), probability_positive=0.326; only 40 of 1,503 games flip pick vs base (17-23 for the plus model, 23-17 for base on those). Candidate Brier 0.24579/log-loss 0.68478 vs base 0.24539/0.68395 -- essentially flat, term does not sharpen calibration either. Reliability tables for base and plus are both well aligned bin-by-bin. No zero-crossing closure per AGENTS.md; this is the decision-relevant cell for whether the term joins the served probability, and it does not yet clear either direction.
opener_error_transfer_added_term_vs_base.description: CFB-trained cover-probability logit added as a fifth fitted term inside the served four-term probability, refit LOSO per NFL season, vs the four-term base, paired accuracy points, Brier, log loss, reliability table.

opener_error_transfer_added_term_vs_base.plain_summary: Adding a college-football opener-mistake signal as a fifth ingredient to the real four-part model neither clearly helps nor clearly hurts yet -- the sample is too small to tell, so it stays off the card.

opener_error_transfer_cfb_direct_vs_base.classification_evidence: Interval entirely below zero (upper -3.76 accuracy points): using the CFB-trained predictor standalone in place of the served four-term probability is resolved worse. On the 750 games where the two disagreed, CFB-direct went 323-427 and base went 427-323.

opener_error_transfer_cfb_direct_vs_base.plain_summary: Picking games purely off the college-football-trained model instead of the real four-part model loses meaningfully more picks -- it is not a stand-in for the served model.

opener_error_transfer_cfb_move_vs_zero.classification_evidence: Season-blocked bootstrap (6 NFL seasons, 4000 draws) interval entirely below zero (upper -0.0077): the CFB-trained move predictor is reliably worse than guessing zero move, not better. Resolved wrong sign for the hypothesis that the shared opener-setting mechanism yields a usable move-size prediction.

opener_error_transfer_nflonly_twin_vs_ba.classification_evidence: Interval entirely below zero (upper -4.40 points): even fit on NFL data only, these 5 features alone underperform the four-term base by a resolved margin -- the shortfall seen training on CFB is feature-set poverty, not only a transfer loss.
